text:
marta: heads-up: canary run for new onboarded model 'vanguard-2q' (int8) shows a parsing regression for toolcall suite. parse_fail jumped from ~0.7% -> 5.9% starting 14:02 UTC. :frowning:
ryan: sample size? which slice?
marta: bench-ci ran 5k toolcall samples (slice-id: 2026-03-23-a). config posted below: model=vanguard-2q, quant=int8, batch_size=8, kv_cache=enabled, stream=on, kernel=attn_v2.
bench-ci: run summary:
```
job: bc-1751
samples: 5000
parse_failure_rate: 0.059
common_error: JSONParseError(trailing-data / duplicate-blob)
funcall_fail_rate: 0.043
```
ash: can we paste a sanitized failing output?
marta: redacted example:
```
{"action":"call","name":"lookup","arguments":{"user_id":"u-1001"}}}

{"action":"call","name":"lookup","arguments":{"user_id":"u-1002"}}
```
ryan: extra closing brace plus concatenated JSON — looks like duplicated suffix from streaming boundary. could be kv-cache replaying a suffix or model emitting duplicate tokens on split decode.
samir: noted pattern: when kv_cache reconstructs a prefix, model sometimes emits end-of-json noise then repeats. quantization (int8) might shift token probabilities causing extra brace token to pop. we've seen similar with int8 in other models.
nash: timeline: did this start after the int8 profile or after kernel change?
marta: both were introduced in the same canary push. earlier int16 kernel-v1 run had parse_fail ~0.9%. so likely interaction.
ryan: triage steps: (A) reproduce with stream=false to see if streaming boundaries are root cause (B) rerun with kv_cache disabled (C) run int16 with new kernel to isolate quant effect.
nash: i'll run (A) and (C) now. samir, can you do (B) and also run the parse-repair telemetry on failures?
samir: starting bc job: `/bench/runner --canary=vanguard-2q --slice=2026-03-23-a --overrides kv_cache=false --limit=1000 --tag=parse-telemetry` (job bc-1752).
triage-bot: alert: canary-vanguard-2q parse_fail rate > 5% for 10m — paging on-call. (auto-note: this is canary, no escalation).
ryan: keep promotion blocked. don't push to prod/dedicated until resolved.
marta: added routing rule to prevent vanguard-2q-int8 promotion.
nash: quick results: int16+attn_v2 => parse_fail 0.012 on same slice. so kernel change alone not enough.
samir: kv_cache-off run (bc-1752) after 1k samples shows parse_fail 0.013. kv_cache seems to be major contributor.
ryan: hypothesis: kv_cache replay + int8 quantization produces tokenization misalignment / duplicate-json suffix. approx mechanism: rounding nudges token scores; when cache replays tokens the generator re-opens small-prob tokens like '}' and then reprints content.
marta: mitigations proposed: 1) gate kv_cache off for int8 quant profiles until we patch runtime 2) ship a soft postprocess heuristic in SDK/canary: on parse failure, attempt suffix-trim up to N chars and re-parse; 3) add telemetry and tagging for any invocation that uses repair so we can estimate false_repair rate.
nash: i can implement the SDK postprocess quickly: naive trim regex and attempt json loads. we'll tag events with header `x-json-repaired: true` when repair used.
samir: i'll add kv_cache gating config: in runtime routing, if model.quant == 'int8' => kv_cache_allowed=false unless opt-in. also emit `kv_cache_blocked` metric.
ryan: tests: run repaired parser across full 5k slice and compute repaired_success_rate and false_repair_rate against gold outputs. bench-ci please queue.
bench-ci: queued bc-1753: full 5k with repairs=on, kv_cache=off. results URL: https://bench.internal/runs/bc-1753
marta: small note: we should store minimal failing examples to S3 bucket (#eng-ml-dumps) for golden/regression set. add sanitized examples and token traces.
ryan: agreed. also run matrix: streaming true/false x batch sizes 1/8/32 with and without kv_cache to pinpoint boundary. queueing now.
triage-bot: incident ticket INC-1751 created for tracking.
bench-ci: bc-1753 completed: repaired_success_rate=0.056 (i.e. many previously failing now parse), overall parse_fail reduced to 0.009, estimated false_repair_rate=0.0015 on gold subset. logs: https://bench.internal/runs/bc-1753/logs
marta: outcome: root cause likely kv_cache + int8 boundary artifact. immediate actions: keep routing block on vanguard-2q-int8, enable kv_cache gating for int8, ship SDK soft-repair as temporary fix, add repaired telemetry and golden set. owners: samir -> runtime gating + metrics, ash -> SDK repair, ryan -> regression dashboard + reruns, marta -> routing + product comms.
ryan: will monitor 24h and reopen if parse_fail > 1% after repairs. thanks team. :thumbsup:
nash: adding unit tests to canary harness to include streaming-split cases.
marta: closing thread after dashboard confirms stability.
